name: G29 + Thrustmaster shifter + ANNX handbrake as one wheel
description: One virtual Logitech G29 carrying the wheel (with force feedback passed through), a Thrustmaster T500 RS shifter (7 gears + R) on the G29's own shifter buttons (gears 1-6 = buttons 13-18, evdev codes 300-303/704/705; reverse = 19, code 706; exactly like a Driving Force Shifter on a real G29) plus gear 7 on an extra button 26 and an ANNX handbrake on an extra axis (ABS_RY). Fixes games that only talk force feedback to the first device they find (Forza Horizon).
